thread:
Emma (CS): Heads-up — Solace Health just opened a formal request to onboard their in-house 13B medical summarizer into a private deployment. They flagged PHI, HSM requirement, and strict latency targets. Looping in @Matt, @Priya, @Jordan to scoping.
Alex (Solace): Thanks Emma :wave: — quick summary from our side: model is a 13B decoder-only trained on clinical notes, will serve high-risk PHI summaries. Need HSM/BYOK, p95 latency <= 300ms, baseline throughput ~20 QPS, and a quantized option if that helps cost. We can provide 1k de-identified examples + 200 PHI ground-truth cases.
Matt (Eng): Got it. Tech notes: 13B, BPE tokenizer, typical seq len 512-1024 but some docs hit 2k. Private deployment + HSM supported; question is whether they want on-prem or VPC-with-HSM-managed. Also need eval harness and perf bench infra.
Priya (Security): Security checklist: we need the threat model, data flow diagram, and a signed DPA for PHI. HSM integration options: customer-managed HSM (on-prem) or Redwood-managed HSM via their KMS — customer must confirm key residency. Also provide expected retention of logs/traces.
Jordan (SE): Suggest an initial evaluation plan: 1) Safety suite: PHI extraction/false-positive rate on 200 ground-truth cases; 2) QA: hallucination rate on 400 clinical QA pairs; 3) Perf: p50/p95 latency and P99 throughput on representative payloads. I can run evals if we get sample data and access. Available Thu 10am PST for a 30m sync.
Alex (Solace): We're leaning VPC with customer BYOK (HSM appliance). I'll share S3 link with samples and add your service account edits. Also flagging this as a potential renewal-risk driver: our renewal next quarter is contingent on meeting latency and accuracy thresholds. If SLA isn't formalized, procurement may push for alternate vendors.
Emma (CS): Noted — marking customer health as "at-risk" until SLA & security slide deck are confirmed. Action items: (a) Alex to share sample data + DPA (b) Matt to propose infra + cost estimate (c) Priya to validate threat model and HSM approach (d) Jordan to schedule eval and bench. I'll create a kickoff doc and capture enablement materials.
Matt (Eng): Quick draft deployment config for discussion (will tweak after samples):
```json
{
  "model": "solace-med-13b",
  "variant": "quant-int4",
  "max_seq": 2048,
  "gpu_profile": "A10x",
  "capacity_target_qps": "20",
  "sla": { "p95_latency_ms": 300 },
  "hsm_required": true
}
```
Matt (Eng): Note — int4 should reduce cost but we need accuracy checks; fallback to fp16 variant if safety eval fails.
Priya (Security): Also need to confirm logging redaction policy. If logs contain PHI we must route to customer-owned S3 and ensure encryption-at-rest with customer key.
deploy-bot: Created ticket CS-7891: "Solace Health — 13B private onboarding (HSM, PHI, perf eval)" and attached initial checklist.
Emma (CS): I'll add renewal risk + exec summary to the ticket. Jordan — can you pick a time for Thu 10am PST?
Jordan (SE): Booked — calendar invite sent to Alex/Emma/Matt/Priya. I'll attach the evaluation template and a small checklist for sample formatting.
Alex (Solace): Invite accepted. Uploading sample set now, grant to redwood-eval@solace-prod. Thanks everyone — looking forward to a quick turnaround.
Emma (CS): Thanks team :thumbsup: — we'll aim for first pass eval within 5 business days after samples are ingested. I'll update account health dashboard and ping renewal ops.
Alex (Solace): Appreciate it. If we can get a POC infra estimate early, that helps procurement.
Matt (Eng): I'll post a rough cost/throughput estimate in the ticket by EOD tomorrow.
Emma (CS): Closing loop for now. Will keep thread updated.
Alex (Solace): Thanks all!
